explanation: The theorem says a ring hom from the Hecke ring to endomorphisms of a Nebentypus character space sends the T_p generator to the restriction of the Hecke operator T_p. It is specific to this library's definitions (heckeRingHomCharSpace, heckeTGeneratorGamma0, heckeTNat). I grepped Mathlib for heckeT, HeckeOperator and heckeRingHom. The only hit was Mathlib/NumberTheory/HeckeRing/Defs.lean, which defines the abstract IsHeckeTriple and has no Hecke operators on modular forms or character spaces. The proof is just ext plus a coe lemma from the library.
